Class SDL_HapticCustom

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<SDL_HapticCustom>
org.lwjgl.sdl.SDL_HapticCustom
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
public class SDL_HapticCustom extends Struct<SDL_HapticCustom> implements NativeResource
struct SDL_HapticCustom {
    SDL_HapticEffectType type;
    SDL_HapticDirection direction;
    Uint32 length;
    Uint16 delay;
    Uint16 button;
    Uint16 interval;
    Uint8 channels;
    Uint16 period;
    Uint16 samples;
    Uint16 * data;
    Uint16 attack_length;
    Uint16 attack_level;
    Uint16 fade_length;
    Uint16 fade_level;
}
